titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Zion Crosses the Sea; Zadok Returns and Solomon Tells His Dream of the Sun (ch. 55–56)
part: ch. 55–56 — Zion Crosses the Sea; Zadok Returns and Solomon Tells His Dream of the Sun
about: The Ethiopians rejoice and set Zion upon a cart; the idols of Egypt fall, the Red Sea quakes, bows to her while its creatures and birds honour her, and they go on past Sinai, Kadesh and Midian to Ethiopia. Then Zadok returns to Solomon, who tells his dream of the sun that left Judah for Ethiopia, and Zadok opens the sanctuary and finds only boards where Zion stood.

sentences.t: ፶፭ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘተፈሥሑ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: 55. Concerning that-which rejoiced men-of Ethiopia
sentences.i: Chapter 55: Concerning how the Ethiopians rejoiced
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፭ is 55 (፶ = 50, ፭ = 5). በእንተ 'concerning' opens the title. ዘተፈሥሑ is ዘ- 'that which / how' + ተፈሥሑ, the 3rd masculine plural perfect of ተፈሥሐ 'rejoiced' (T-stem of ፈሥሐ); the clause is a noun-clause after 'concerning'. ሰብአ ኢትዮጵያ is a construct chain, 'men-of Ethiopia'.

sentences.t: ወአኀዙ ፡ ዕንዚራተ ፡ ወነፍኁ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ወከበሮ ፡ ወብዕዛ ፡ ወበቃለ ፡ ማሕሌቶሙ ፡ ወፍሥሓሆሙ ፡ ተሀውከት ፡ ወደምፀት ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወኀብሩ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ውውዓ ፡ ወማሕሌት ፤
sentences.l: And-they-took-up harps and-they-blew horn and-drum and-ብዕዛ (?), and at-voice-of their-song and-their-joy was-stirred and-resounded river-of Egypt, and-they-joined with-them ውውዓ (?) and-song;
sentences.i: And they took up harps and blew the horn and drum and the bəʿza (?); and at the sound of their song and their joy the river of Egypt was stirred and resounded, and they joined with them in ውውዓ (?) and song;
sentences.n: ወአኀዙ 'and they began / took hold' (አኀዘ + plural), with ዕንዚራተ 'harps' in the accusative (-ተ). ቀርነ 'horn' and ከበሮ 'drum' (the -ሮ is not a suffix). ብዕዛ is UNCERTAIN: I take it as another musical instrument, but I cannot say which. In ወበቃለ ማሕሌቶሙ the construct ቃለ 'voice-of' governs the chain; ተሀውከት (stirred, T-stem of ሀወከ) and ደምፀት (resounded) are 3rd feminine singular, agreeing with ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river-of Egypt', most likely the Nile (?). The feminine verbs sit beside masculine ፈለግ; they agree rather with ግብጽ, a feminine country-name (?). ወኀብሩ 'and they joined' has no stated subject (the Egyptians? ?); ውውዓ is UNCERTAIN, perhaps a cry or shout of acclamation. ፤ ends the unit.

sentences.t: ወወድቁ ፡ ጣዖታቲሆሙ ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ በእደዊሆሙ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወከልብ ፡ ወድመት ፡ ወዓዲ ፡ ማኅፈደ ፡ ነዋኃት ፡ ወእለ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ አንስርት ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፡ ወድቁ ፡ ወተቀጥቀጡ ፤
sentences.l: And-fell their-idols which they-made with-their-hands, likeness-of man and-dog and-cat, and-also ማኅፈደ ነዋኃት (?) and-those with-them, likeness-of eagles of-gold and-silver, fell and-were-shattered;
sentences.i: And their idols fell, which they had made with their hands in the likeness of man and dog and cat; and also the tall towers (?) and the images of eagles, of gold and silver, that were with them fell and were shattered;
sentences.n: ጣዖታቲሆሙ 'their idols' (ጣዖት + plural -ት + ሆሙ). ዘገብሩ 'which they made'; አምሳለ is the construct 'likeness-of', so አምሳለ ሰብእ ወከልብ ወድመት is 'likeness of man and dog and cat'. ማኅፈደ ነዋኃት is UNCERTAIN: I take ማኅፈድ as 'tower, turret' and ነዋኃት as the plural of ነዊሕ 'tall', giving 'tall towers'; the phrase could be something else. ወእለ ምስሌሆሙ 'and those with them' is loose, and I read it as the eagle-images set beside the idols (?). ተቀጥቀጡ is the T-stem of ቀጥቀጠ 'crush, shatter'. The idols falling before the Ark recalls 1 Samuel 5, where Dagon falls before the Ark.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ታበርህ ፡ ወእምግርማሃ ፡ ይደነግፁ ፤
sentences.l: for like sun she-shines, and-from-her-awe they-tremble;
sentences.i: for she shines like the sun, and they tremble at the terror of her;
sentences.n: The 'she' is Zion, the Ark (ታቦት). ታበርህ is the causative አብርሀ 'cause to shine' (3rd feminine imperfect), which in Geʿez is the ordinary verb 'shine'. ግርማ 'awe, terror' with ሃ 'her'; እም- 'from' gives the cause of the trembling; ይደነግፁ 'they are terrified' (ደንገፀ). ከመ ፀሐይ 'like the sun' likens Zion to the sun, as in chapter 54, and prepares the sun image of the dream in chapter 56.

sentences.t: ወአልበስዋ ፡ አልባሲሃ ፡ ወጾሩ ፡ ሞጻሃ ፡ ቅድሜሃ ፡ ወአንበርዋ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ ነጺፎሙ ፡ ሜላተ ፡ ታሕቴሃ ፡ ወፀፊሮሙ ፡ ሜላተ ፡ በመልዕልቴሃ ፡ ወይሔልዩ ፡ ማሕሌተ ፡ በቅድሜሃ ፡ ወበድኅሬሃ ።
sentences.l: And-they-clothed-her her-garments, and-they-bore her-fringe(?) before-her, and-they-set-her upon cart, having-spread cloth(?) beneath-her and-having-ፀፊሮሙ (?) cloth(?) above-her; and they-sing song before-her and-behind-her.
sentences.i: They clothed her in her garments and carried her fringe (?) before her, and set her upon a cart, with cloth (?) spread beneath her and cloth (?) draped (?) above her; and they sang a song before her and behind her.
sentences.n: ወአልበስዋ 'and they clothed her' (causative of ለበሰ, with ዋ 'her') and አልባሲሃ 'her garments'. ሞጻ is UNCERTAIN: the same word is in the chapter 56 heading (spelled ሞፃ). Here it follows 'they bore (ጾሩ) ... before her', so some object carried in procession. Chapters 51–52 render it 'hem, fringe (?)' (the keepsake Zadok is to bring with Zion's garment), and I keep that house reading: 'her fringe (?)', with ሃ 'her'. አንበርዋ 'they set her' (causative of ነበረ 'sit'). ነጺፎሙ ... ፀፊሮሙ are gerund forms with -ሙ ('they having spread ... having ...'); the second verb is UNCERTAIN: I take ፀፈረ as 'weave, plait, drape'. ሜላተ is an obscure word for something spread or laid, perhaps a covering (?) (as in the published parts; ch. 29 leaves it untranslated), here in the accusative. ታሕቴሃ 'beneath her' and በመልዕልቴሃ 'above her' have the suffix ሃ. ይሔልዩ is a plural imperfect used for continuing action, 'they sing'. ሰረገላ here is the vehicle carrying the Ark, rendered 'cart' as in chapters 30 and 49–53.

sentences.t: ወተንሥኡ ፡ ሰረገላትኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡ ወጌሡ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሔልዩ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወተላዐሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ መጠነ ፡ እመት ፤
sentences.l: And-arose the-carts-also as formerly and-journeyed in-morning, while they-sing to-her, and-were-lifted-up all-of-them to-the-measure-of a-cubit;
sentences.i: And the carts too rose as before and set out in the morning, while they sang to her, and all of them were lifted up the measure of a cubit;
sentences.n: ሰረገላትኒ 'the carts, also': ሰረገላት is the plural, and the enclitic -ኒ adds 'also / indeed'. ከመ ቀዲሙ 'as formerly'. ጌሡ 'they journeyed' (ጌሠ). እንዘ ይሔልዩ ... 'while they sing' is a circumstantial clause (እንዘ + imperfect). ላቲ is ለ- + ቲ 'to her'. ተላዐሉ 'were raised' (T-stem of ላዐለ), a miracle: the travellers or carts rode a cubit above the ground (meaning ambiguous, since ኵሎሙ 'all of them' is masculine plural). መጠነ እመት 'to-the-measure-of a cubit' (construct; a cubit is roughly half a metre).

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ያስተፉንውዎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽላሎት ፡ ወሰገዱ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እስመ ፡ ርእይዋ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትረውጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፤
sentences.l: while they-escort-them (?) the-men-of land-of Egypt, they-passed before-them like shadow, and-bowed to-them the-men-of land-of Egypt, for they-saw-her while she-runs like sun in-the-midst-of heaven;
sentences.i: while the men of Egypt escorted them (?), they passed before them like a shadow; and the men of Egypt bowed down to them, for they saw her running like the sun in the midst of heaven;
sentences.n: ያስተፉንውዎሙ is UNCERTAIN: a causative-reflexive of ፈነወ 'send', so 'send them off / escort them' (?); the Egyptians might instead be supplying them. ሰብአ ብሔረ ግብጽ is a double construct chain, 'men-of land-of Egypt'. ከመ ጽላሎት 'like a shadow' describes the speed of passing. ሰገዱ ሎሙ 'they bowed to them' (ሎሙ = ለ- + ሙ). ርእይዋ 'they saw her' (ርእየ + ዋ); ትረውጽ 'she runs' (ሮጸ), with the Ark as subject, and እንዘ gives the circumstance. በውስተ ሰማይ 'in the midst of heaven'. The Egyptians' homage to the Ark echoes the fall of the idols (unit 2).

sentences.t: ወኵሎሙ ፡ ይረውጹ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ እንዘይረውጹ ፡ በቅድሜሃ ፡ ወበድኅሬሃ ።
sentences.l: and-all-of-them they-run with the-cart, while-they-run before-her and-behind-her.
sentences.i: and all of them ran beside the cart, running before her and behind her.
sentences.n: እንዘይረውጹ is printed as one word (እንዘ + ይረውጹ) in the source; I keep it as printed. ይረውጹ 'they run' (ሮጸ); በሰረገላ 'with / by the cart' (በ- is loose here, perhaps 'alongside'). Matches the processional order of unit 4: ቅድሜሃ ወበድኅሬሃ 'before her and behind her'.

sentences.t: ወበጽሑ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ አልአሕመር ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ኢርትራ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሠጥቀት ፡ በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወኬዱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ መዓምቅቲሃ ፡ ዐቀበ ፡ ወቊልቊለ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢተውህበት ፡ አሜሃ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ጠግዐ ፡ ማይ ፡ አረፍትበይምን ፡ ወአረፍት ፡ በፅግም ፡ ወአኅለፎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ምስለ ፡ እንስሳሆሙ ፡ ወደቂቆሙ ፡ ወአንስቲያሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-reached sea Red, which that-is sea-of Ertra, which was-split by hand-of Moses, and-walked children-of Israel into its-depths up-and-down (?), for not-was-given then to-Moses ark-of his-law of-God; and for-this congealed (?) water ‘walls’ (?) on-the-right and-‘walls’ (?) on-the-left, and-he-made-pass-them, Israel, with their-flocks and-their-children and-their-women;
sentences.i: And they reached the Red Sea, which is the Erythraean Sea, that was split by the hand of Moses, and the children of Israel walked into its depths, up and down (?), since the Ark of the Law of God had not then been given to Moses; and for this reason the water stood firm (?) as walls (?) on the right and walls (?) on the left, and He brought Israel across with their flocks and their children and their women;
sentences.n: Exodus 14, the crossing of the sea. ባሕረ አልአሕመር is Arabic al-aḥmar 'the red', so 'Red Sea'; ባሕረ ኢርትራ is the Greek 'Erythraean' ('red') sea. እንተ ይእቲ 'which is' equates the two names. ተሠጥቀት 'was split' (T-stem of ሠጠቀ), feminine to agree with ባሕር; በእደ ሙሴ 'by the hand of Moses'. ኬዱ 'they walked'. ዐቀበ ወቊልቊለ is UNCERTAIN: I read ዐቀብ 'ascent' and ቊልቊል 'descent' as accusatives of manner, 'up and down' (the sea-floor uneven). For ጠግዐ ማይ, ጠግዐ is UNCERTAIN, perhaps 'thickened, stood firm' (compare Exodus 15:8 where the waters 'congealed'). አረፍትበይምን is printed as one word and is a fusion of አረፍት + በይምን, 'x on the right' (ይምን = right, የማን); አረፍት is UNCERTAIN, 'sides / walls (?)' (it recurs in the last unit). ወአረፍት በፅግም is the matching 'and x on the left' (ፅግም = ፀጋም 'left'); the second አረፍት is separated by a ፡ here, which confirms the split. ኢተውህበት 'was not given' is the T-passive of ወሀበ, 3rd feminine, with ታቦተ ሕጉ as its subject in the -ä form (?). Chapters 17–20 also read አረፍት as 'wall' (?). The reason clause (the Ark not yet given to Moses) explains why the sea needed the Ark's help. ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass' is the causative of ኀለፈ, with God as the unstated subject; ለእስራኤል repeats the object. እንስሳሆሙ 'their flocks / animals'.

sentences.t: ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዐደዉ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ተናገሮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ ምስለ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ሕግ ።
sentences.l: And after they-crossed the-sea, spoke-with-him God and-gave-him ark-of covenant with book-of law.
sentences.i: And after they had crossed the sea, God spoke with him and gave him the Ark of the Covenant with the book of the Law.
sentences.n: ዐደዉ 'they crossed' (ዐደወ). ተናገሮ is ተናገረ 'spoke' + ዎ 'him', Moses; ወወሀቦ 'and gave him' is ወሀበ + ዎ. Moses receiving the Law is Sinai (Exodus 19–31). ታቦተ ኪዳን and መጽሐፈ ሕግ are construct chains ('ark-of covenant', 'book-of law'). The author's chronology: the Ark is given after the crossing, which the next unit takes up.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ተዐዱ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ምስለ ፡ እሊአሃ ፡ አሜሃ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሔልዩ ፡ ማሕሌተ ፡ በመሰንቆ ፡ ወበዕንዚራት ፡ ባሕርኒ ፡ ተቀበለቶሙ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ታንፈርዕጽ ፡ መዋግዲሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይትበተኩ ፡ አድባር ፡ ነዋኃት ፡ ወከመ ፡ ድምፀ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ዘይጥሕር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ በገንሕ ፡ ትደምፅ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ነጐድጓደ ፡ ክረምተ ፡ ደማስቆ ፡ ወኢትዮጵያ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይዘብጦን ፡ መብረቅ ፡ ለደመናት ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ታንጐደጒድ ፡ ወኀብረ ፡ ነጐድጓድ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዕንዚራት ፡ ወሰገደት ፡ ላቲ ፡ ባሕርኒ ፤
sentences.l: And when crossed Zion holy with her-ones then who with-her, while they-sing song with-lyre and-with-harps, the-sea-also received-them, while quaked its-waves like when are-shattered mountains tall, and-like voice-of lion which roars, thus in-ገንሕ (?) it-resounds, and-like thunder-of rainy-season-of Damascus and-Ethiopia when strikes-them lightning to-the-clouds, thus it-thunders, and-joined thunder with harps, and-bowed to-her the-sea-also;
sentences.i: And when holy Zion crossed, with those of hers who were then with her, singing a song with lyre and with harps, the sea too received them; its waves quaked as when tall mountains are shattered, and, like the voice of a lion that roars, so it resounded, loudly (?); and, like the thunder of the rainy season of Damascus and Ethiopia when lightning strikes the clouds, so it thundered; and the thunder joined with the harps, and the sea too bowed down to her;
sentences.n: One long sentence with no inner ፤, kept whole. ተዐዱ 'crossed' (T-stem of ዐደወ; an odd form, as noted at ch. 17–20, where a regular 3rd plural perfect would be ተዐደዉ, so the parse is uncertain) is plural in sense though ጽዮን is feminine singular; it takes in her company, ምስለ እሊአሃ አሜሃ እንተ ኀቤሃ 'with those of hers then, who (were) with her'. መሰንቆ 'lyre' and ዕንዚራት 'harps'. ተቀበለቶሙ 'she received them' (ተቀበለት 3rd feminine singular, the sea ባሕር as subject, + ሙ 'them'); ባሕርኒ 'the sea also'. ታንፈርዕጽ 'it quaked' is a quadriliteral reflexive (?); መዋግዲሃ 'its waves'. ሶበ ይትበተኩ 'when they are shattered'. አድባር ነዋኃት 'tall mountains' (አድባር = ደብር plural). The similes follow ከመ 'like': ድምፀ አንበሳ 'voice-of lion', ዘይጥሕር 'which roars'. በገንሕ is UNCERTAIN: I guess 'loudly / fiercely' (?). ነጐድጓደ ክረምተ 'thunder-of the rainy season' is a double construct; ደማስቆ is Damascus. ይዘብጦን 'it strikes them' (feminine plural suffix -ሆን), ዘብጠ 'strike'; ታንጐደጒድ 'it thunders'. ኀብረ is the verb 'joined', with the thunder as subject (not a noun-chain here). The sea does homage as the Egyptians did (unit 6).

sentences.t: ወእንዘ ፡ ይትሀወክ ፡ መዋግዲሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ አድባር ፡ ተለዐለ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ መዋግድ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ፫ ፡ እመት ፡ ወበዜማ ፡ ማሕሌቶሙ ፡ መንክር ፡ ተላህያ ፡ ለባሕር ፤
sentences.l: And while shook its-waves like mountains, was-lifted-up their-carts above waves to-the-measure-of 3 cubits; and at-melody-of their-song marvelous ተላህያ (?) to-the-sea;
sentences.i: And while its waves shook like mountains, their carts were lifted up above the waves three cubits; and at the melody of their song, a marvel, there was delight (?) for the sea;
sentences.n: ይትሀወክ 'is shaken' (T-stem of ሀወከ, as in unit 1). ተለዐለ 'was raised' is singular though ሰረገላቲሆሙ ('their carts', plural + ሆሙ) is plural, a loose agreement kept as printed. ፫ is the numeral 3, standing as its own word between ፡ marks (the build will treat it as a number: spoken ሠለስቱ). መልዕልተ መዋግድ 'above the waves' (construct). ዜማ 'melody'. ተላህያ is UNCERTAIN: it recurs three times in units 11–12, each time ending ተላህያ ለባሕር, and I cannot parse it. I take it as a noun, 'delight (?)', 'a delight to the sea', because in the next unit the adjectives ግሩም, መድምም, ዐዚዝ, ዕፁብ need something to qualify and ለባሕር is a dative; a verb 'was enchanted' would leave them without a subject. The sense is only a guess from context. It is printed as one word and is not corrected. መንክር 'marvelous' modifies ዜማ.

sentences.t: ግሩም ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወመድምም ፡ ተላህያ ፡ ለባሕር ፡ ዐዚዝ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወዕፁብ ፡ ተላህያ ፡ ለባሕር ፡ ወእለ ፡ ውስቴታሂ ፡ አራዊት ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዐወቁ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ኢያስተርእዩ ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወአዕዋፍኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ይጠፍሑ ፡ በክነፊሆሙ ፡ ወይጼልልዋ ፤
sentences.l: Awesome exceedingly and-astonishing ተላህያ (?) to-the-sea, mighty greatly and-wondrous ተላህያ (?) to-the-sea; and-those within-it-also, beasts, those who are-known and-those who not-ያስተርእዩ (?), come-out and-bow to-her; and-the-birds-also, those within-it, spread with-their-wings and-they-shade-her;
sentences.i: Awesome beyond measure and astounding was the delight (?) for the sea; mighty and wondrous was the delight (?) for the sea; and the creatures within it, both those that are known and those that do not appear (?), come out and bow down to her; and the birds that are in it spread their wings and shade her;
sentences.n: The two adjective pairs ግሩም ... መድምም and ዐዚዝ ... ዕፁብ ('awesome / astonishing', 'mighty / wondrous') are all praise of the song's effect; for ተላህያ see the note on unit 11 (UNCERTAIN, rendered as the noun 'delight (?)', with the adjectives qualifying it). ወእለ ውስቴታሂ አራዊት 'and those within it, the beasts': ውስቴታሂ is ውስቴታ + ሂ 'also / indeed'. ይትዐወቁ 'they are known' (T-stem of ዐወቀ). ወእለ ኢያስተርእዩ is UNCERTAIN: ያስተርእዩ is the causative-reflexive of ርእየ 'show / appear', so 'those which do not appear (?)', meaning unseen creatures of the deep; the ወ belongs to እለ (ወእለ ኢያስተርእዩ 'and those who do not ...'). ይወፅኡ 'they come out' and ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her'. አዕዋፍኒ 'the birds also'. ይጠፍሑ 'they spread out' (ጠፍሐ, as in ch. 53) and ይጼልልዋ 'they shade her' (ጸለለ + ዋ). Sea creatures worshipping the Ark is a Psalm 148 motif ('sea monsters ... praise').

sentences.t: ወኮነ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ለባሕረ ፡ ኢርትራ ፡ ወለሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወወፅኡ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እምነ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ እምግብጽ ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ ወበህየኒ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሴብሑ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወያኀብሩ ፡ ስብሐቶሙ ፡ መንፈሳዊያን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ መሬታዊያን ፡ በማሕሌት ፡ ወበመዝሙር ፡ በከበሮ ፡ ወበትፍሥሕት ።
sentences.l: And-was joy to-the-sea-of Ertra and-to-men-of Ethiopia, and-they-came-out the-sea and-rejoiced exceedingly more-than Israel when they-came-out from-Egypt, and-reached opposite mount-of Sinai and-encamped in Kadesh, and-there-also, while they-praise the-angels, and-they-join their-praise the-spiritual-ones with children-of the-earthly-ones, in-song and-in-psalm, with-drum and-with-rejoicing.
sentences.i: And there was joy for the Erythraean Sea and for the Ethiopians; and they came out of the sea and rejoiced even more than Israel when they came out of Egypt; and they reached the place opposite Mount Sinai and encamped at Kadesh. And there too, while the angels praised, the spiritual ones joined their praise with the sons of the earthly, in song and in psalm, with drum and rejoicing.
sentences.n: One long unit, kept whole (no inner ፤). ወኮነ ፍሥሓ 'and there was joy'. ወወፅኡ ባሕረ 'they came out [of] the sea' (ባሕረ is accusative). ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced exceedingly more than Israel', the comparison with Exodus 14–15, the Song of the Sea. They then retrace Israel's route: አንጻረ ደብረ ሲና 'opposite Mount Sinai' (Exodus 19) and ቃዴስ Kadesh (Numbers 20, Kadesh-barnea). ወበህየኒ 'and there also'. ይሴብሑ 'they praise' (ሴበሐ) and ያኀብሩ 'they join' (causative of ኀብረ). መንፈሳዊያን 'spiritual ones' (angels) and መሬታዊያን 'earthly ones' (men) are adjectives made nouns; ደቂቀ መሬታዊያን is a construct, 'children-of the earthly'. ትፍሥሕት 'rejoicing'. The author makes the angelic liturgy and the earthly one one chorus; the unit ends at ። with no ፤ to cut.

sentences.t: ወእምሂየ ፡ ጸዐኑ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ ወተንሥኡ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ወኀለፍዋ ፡ ለብሔረምድያም ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ቤሎንቶስ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: And from-there they-loaded their-carts and-they-arose and-went and-passed-her to-land-of-Midian and-reached city ቤሎንቶስ (?) which city-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: And from there they loaded (?) their carts and rose and went, and passed by the land of Midian, and reached the city of Belontos (?), a city of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: እምሂየ 'from there' (እምህየ with the extra ሂ as printed). ጸዐኑ 'they loaded', perhaps 'mounted' (?) (ጸዐነ). ሰረገላቲሆሙ 'their carts' is a regular plural + suffix, here as accusative. ወኀለፍዋ ለብሔረምድያም 'and they passed it, [namely] the land of Midian': ብሔረምድያም is printed as one word (ብሔረ ምድያም, construct 'land-of Midian'), and ኀለፍዋ 'passed her' with the object repeated by ለ-. ሀገረ ቤሎንቶስ 'city-of Belontos': the name is UNCERTAIN, I cannot place it (it may be a corrupt form of a Greek or Ethiopian place name); ሀገረ ኢትዮጵያ 'a city of Ethiopia'.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሑ ፡ በህየኒ ፡ ወአዕረፉ ፡ እስመ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ በክብር ፡ ወበፍሥሓ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ፃማ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ነፉስ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወሚካኤል ፡ ሊቀ ፡ መላእክት ፤
sentences.l: and-they-rejoiced there-also and-rested, for ደወለ (?) their-land they-reached in-glory and-in-joy without toil on-the-road, in-cart ነፉስ (?) with host-of heaven and-Michael chief-of angels;
sentences.i: and they rejoiced there too and rested, for they had reached the border (?) of their land in glory and in joy, without toil on the road, in a cart of wind (?), with the host of heaven and Michael, the chief of the angels;
sentences.n: ተፈሥሑ 'rejoiced', አዕረፉ 'rested' (አዕረፈ). እስመ ደወለ ብሔሮሙ is UNCERTAIN: I read ደወለ as a construct noun 'border / edge-of' (?) governing ብሔሮሙ 'their land' (ብሔር + ሙ); on that reading በጽሑ 'they reached' is the main verb. ዘእንበለ ፃማ 'without toil'. በሰረገላ ነፉስ: ነፉስ is UNCERTAIN, perhaps 'of wind / airy' (cf. ነፍሐ 'blow'), as the cart rode above the ground. ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host-of heaven' (construct), ሊቀ መላእክት 'chief-of angels' (ሊቅ is 'chief, elder'); the archangel Michael escorts the Ark.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አድያመ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እስመ ፡ ታበርህ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ በጽሐት ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-they-rejoiced all regions-of Ethiopia, for shines Zion where she-reached, like sun in the-midst-of darkness.
sentences.i: and all the regions of Ethiopia rejoiced, for Zion shines wherever she has arrived, like the sun in the midst of darkness.
sentences.n: አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ is a construct, 'regions-of Ethiopia' (አድያም 'regions, sides'). ኀበ በጽሐት 'where she arrived' (3rd feminine perfect). ከመ ፀሐይ በውስተ ጽልመት 'like the sun in the midst of darkness': the Ark-as-sun is the motif that carries into the dream of chapter 56. The row of ፨ marks (eight in the source) ends chapter 55, and is kept on this last unit.

sentences.t: ፶፮ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ግብአተ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ውሂቦ ፡ ሞፃ ።
sentences.l: 56. Concerning return-of Zadok priest, his-giving fringe (?)
sentences.i: Chapter 56: Concerning the return of Zadok the priest, his giving of the fringe (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፮ is 56 (፶ = 50, ፮ = 6). ግብአተ 'return' is the construct of ግብአት, the verbal noun of ገብአ 'return', governing ሳዶቅ ካህን 'Zadok the priest'. ውሂቦ is the verbal noun ውሂብ 'giving' with ዎ 'his'. ሞፃ is UNCERTAIN: the same word is spelled ሞጻ in chapter 55 (unit 4); chapters 51–52 render ሞጻ 'hem, fringe (?)', and I keep that house reading (Zadok is the one who brings Zion's garment and fringe). With the suffix ዎ, ውሂቦ is no construct, so ሞፃ is its object. Here the name is spelled ሳዶቅ, but see ሰዶቅ in the later units; both are printed so in the source.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወረከቦ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይቴክዝ ፡ አውሥኦ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ለሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አመ ፡ ትመጽእ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ አስተርአየኒ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ በሌሊት ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘእቀውም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቀመራ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወረደ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወአብርሃ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወጐንዲያ ፡ ዐረበት ፡ ወአብርሀት ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወኢገብአት ፡ ዳግመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፤
sentences.l: And when returned Zadok priest to Solomon king, and-found-him while he-is-troubled, answered-him the-king, to-Zadok priest, and-said-to-him: When comes queen, appeared-to-me thus in-night, as one-who I-stand in ቀመራ (?) of-Jerusalem; descended sun from-heaven into land-of Judah and-shone exceedingly, and-having-lingered (?) set and-shone to-the-land-of Ethiopia and-not-returned again into land-of Judah;
sentences.i: And when Zadok the priest returned to King Solomon and found him troubled, the king answered Zadok the priest and said to him: When the queen came, this appeared to me in the night, as though I stood in the ቀመራ (?) of Jerusalem: the sun came down from heaven into the land of Judah and shone exceedingly; then, having lingered (?), it set, and shone upon the land of Ethiopia, and did not return again to the land of Judah;
sentences.n: ሶበ ገብአ 'when he returned'; ወረከቦ 'and found him' (ረከበ + ዎ). እንዘ ይቴክዝ 'while he is troubled' (T-stem of ከዘ, 'to grieve'). አውሥኦ 'he answered him' (አውሥአ + ዎ) with the king as subject. ይቤሎ 'said to him'. አመ ትመጽእ ንግሥት: አመ 'when' with the imperfect ትመጽእ 'she comes', the time of the queen's visit; the tense is ambiguous and I read it as past in the dream's frame. አስተርአየኒ 'appeared to me' (ኒ = 'me'). ከመዝ 'thus'. ከመ ዘእቀውም 'as one who I stand' (ዘ + 1st singular imperfect), 'as though I stood'. ቀመራ is UNCERTAIN: a place or feature of Jerusalem where he stands (a height, a wall-top, ?). ብሔረ ይሁዳ 'land-of Judah'. ፀሐይ takes masculine verbs here (ወረደ, ወአብርሃ) and then feminine ones (ዐረበት, ወአብርሀት, ወኢገብአት: 'set, shone, did not return'). ጐንዲያ is, as in ch. 30, the feminine gerund of ጐንደየ 'linger, delay' (?), 'having lingered', agreeing with the sun as subject of ዐረበት 'set'. ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ marks 'the land of Ethiopia' as the object of ወአብርሀት 'shone upon'. This is the sun-dream: the sun that leaves Judah for Ethiopia stands for the glory (Zion/the Ark) that goes with Menelik. The unit is long (44 words) but has no inner ፤.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ወረደ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወአብርሃ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እምቀዲሙ ፡ ወተሀየይዎ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወፈቀዱ ፡ ይድፍኑ ፡ ብርሃኖ ፡ ወሠረቀ ፡ እንተ ፡ መትሕተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ኢተሐዘብዎ ፡ ወአብርሃ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ሮሜ ፡ ወለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወእምድኅሬሁ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ አምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ።
sentences.l: And again descended sun from-heaven into land-of Judah and-shone exceedingly more-than formerly, and-ተሀየይዎ (?) Israel and-wished to-cover its-light, and-it-rose, that beneath earth, from-where not-they-reckoned, and-shone to-land-of Rome and-to-land-of Ethiopia, and after-it for-all those who believed in-him.
sentences.i: And again the sun came down from heaven into the land of Judah and shone more brightly than before; and Israel set itself against it (?) and wished to cover its light; and it rose from beneath the earth, from where they had not expected, and shone upon the land of Rome and the land of Ethiopia, and after it upon all those who believed in him.
sentences.n: ካዕበ 'again'. እምቀዲሙ 'than before' (the comparative እም-). ተሀየይዎ is UNCERTAIN in sense: it looks like the 3rd masculine plural perfect of ተሀየየ (ch. 30 ተሀየዮሙ 'he turned away from them, or was angry with them (?)'; ch. 54 ወኢትትሀየዪ 'do not be slack (?)') with ዎ 'him/it' as object and Israel as the subject; here some hostile or contemptuous act (they turned against it, opposed it, ?). ፈቀዱ ይድፍኑ 'they wished to cover' (ደፈነ 'cover, shut in'; the same stem as ተደፍነ in unit 23). ብርሃኖ 'its light' (ዎ is masculine 'his / its', so the light is also read as 'his light'). ወሠረቀ 'and it rose' (ሠረቀ is the verb for sunrise). እንተ መትሕተ ምድር 'that beneath the earth'. ኢተሐዘብዎ 'they did not reckon it' (ተሐዘበ 'think, expect'). ሮሜ 'Rome' stands for the nations. እለ አምኑ ቦቱ 'those who believed in him' (ቦቱ masculine). The theology (a traditional reading, as at ch. 30; the passage itself only says 'sun'): the sun is taken as Christ (and the Ark/Zion), refused by Israel, rising among the nations and Ethiopia; the reader should hear the Christian light-imagery (Malachi 4:2, John 1) here.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ዘኢነገርከኒ ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡ ዘከመዝ ፡ አርአያ ፡ ዘርኢከ ፤
sentences.l: And answered Zadok priest and-said: My-lord, why that-not you-told-me formerly such vision which you-saw?
sentences.i: And Zadok the priest answered and said: My lord, why did you not tell me before of such a vision as you saw?
sentences.n: አውሥአ 'answered' (causative of ወሥአ, the regular 'answer'), ይቤ 'said'. እግዚእየ 'my lord' (እግዚእ + የ). ለምንት 'why'. ዘኢነገርከኒ 'that you did not tell me' (ነገረ, ኒ 'me'), a ዘ- clause. ዘከመዝ 'such, of this kind'. አርአያ 'vision, appearance' is accusative. ዘርኢከ 'which you saw'. Note the spelling ሳዶቅ here and ሰዶቅ in units 26 and 28; the source prints both.

sentences.t: አርዐድከኒ ፡ ለብረክየ ፤
sentences.l: you-made-tremble-me, to-my-knees.
sentences.i: You have made my knees tremble.
sentences.n: አርዐድከኒ is the causative of ረዐደ 'tremble', 'you made-tremble (me)', with ኒ 'me'. ለብረክየ is ለ- + ብረክ 'knee' + የ 'my' with ለ- marking the part affected, 'as to my knees'. A very short unit by design: it stands between two ፤.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ ደቂቅነ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ነሥእዋ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: Woe to-us our-children, if they-took-her, our-lady Zion holy heavenly, ark-of his-law of-God.
sentences.i: Woe to us and to our children, if they have taken her, our lady Zion, the holy and heavenly one, the Ark of the Law of God.
sentences.n: አሌ ለነ 'woe to us'; ደቂቅነ 'our children' is in apposition (so 'to our children' too). ለእመ 'if'. ነሥእዋ 'they took her' (ነሥአ + ዋ), with the object named afterwards by ለእግዝእትነ 'our lady' (ለ- repeating the suffix); the 'they' is not named. ሰማያዊት is 'heavenly' in the feminine, to agree with ጽዮን. ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark-of his-law, of God' (ሕጉ 'his law', the suffix anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር). Zadok's fear is that the Ark has gone: the dream reads as the Ark leaving Judah for Ethiopia.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ተረስዐ ፡ ጥበብነ ፡ ወተደፍነ ፡ ኅሊናነ ፤
sentences.l: And answered the-king and-said-to-him: was-spoiled (?) our-wisdom, and-was-covered our-mind;
sentences.i: And the king answered and said to him: Our wisdom has been spoiled (?), and our mind has been covered over;
sentences.n: ተረስዐ ጥበብነ 'our wisdom was spoiled' (T-stem of ረስዐ, which is 'forget' in ch. 9–12, 24, 31–32 and, causative, 'bring to ruin' in ch. 54; 'spoiled, lost' is a guess, ?). ወተደፍነ ኅሊናነ: ተደፍነ is the 3rd masculine singular perfect (a 1st plural would be ተደፈንነ), so ኅሊናነ 'our mind' is its subject: 'our mind was covered', i.e. 'blinded'. ኅሊና 'mind, thought'. Solomon admits that his wisdom failed to read the dream.

sentences.t: በአማን ፡ አምሳሊሃ ፡ ለፀሐይ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ዘአስተርአየኒ ፡ አሜሃ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀሎኩ ፡ ንዉምየ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንግሥተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: in-truth, her-likeness of-the-sun, Zion holy, which appeared-to-me then, while I-was my-sleeping with queen-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: In truth it was holy Zion, the likeness of the sun, who appeared to me then, while I lay asleep with the queen of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: በአማን 'in truth'. አምሳሊሃ ለፀሐይ 'the likeness of the sun': the suffix ሃ anticipates the owner, ለፀሐይ, so ጽዮን ቅድስት 'holy Zion' is the one named. ዘአስተርአየኒ 'who appeared to me'. እንዘ ሀሎኩ ንዉምየ 'while I was asleep': ሀሎኩ 'I was', ንዉም 'asleep' + የ, which is printed as if 'my asleep' (a suffix that behaves like 'I'). ምስለ ንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ 'with the queen of Ethiopia', the Queen of Sheba (Makeda). The source says 'then': the dream is dated to the night he lay with her.

sentences.t: ወባሕቱ ፡ ንግረኒ ፡ እስኩ ፡ ትማልም ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትነሥእ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ተውንያ ፡ ዘቃማ ፡ እምላዕሌሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ኢጠየቀኑ ፡ ህላዌሃ ።
sentences.l: but tell-me, please, yesterday, when you-took her-garment, ተውንያ (?) ዘቃማ (?), from upon-her, of-Zion, did-he(?)-not-examine her-being?
sentences.i: But tell me, I pray, yesterday, when you took her garment [ተውንያ (?) ዘቃማ (?)] from Zion, did you not examine her very being?
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ 'but'. ንግረኒ 'tell me' (imperative of ነገረ). እስኩ 'please'. ትማልም 'yesterday'. ሶበ ትነሥእ 'when you take (took)'. ልብሳ 'her garment'. ተውንያ ዘቃማ: both words are UNCERTAIN; I take them as an appositive naming the garment, but I cannot translate them, so the English leaves them in brackets. ቃማ is also in ch. 51–52 (ቃማ ዘወርቅ), likewise unidentified. እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon her, from Zion'. ኢጠየቀኑ is formally 3rd masculine singular (a 2nd person would be ኢጠየቅከኑ); the sense needs 'you', so the form may be slipped (?). It is the negative of ጠየቀ 'examine, verify closely' + the question-particle -ኑ, 'did you not examine?'. ህላዌሃ 'her being, her presence' (ህላዌ, from ሀሎ 'be').

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ ሰዶቅ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፫ ፡ ልብስ ፡ በኀቤሃ ፡ ነሣእኩ ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ወአልበስክዋ ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሀብከኒ ፡ ወአምጻእኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
sentences.l: Answered Zadok and-said: Not-so, O-lord, for 3 garment with-her I-took, that upon-her, and-I-clothed-her that which you-gave-me, and-I-brought to-you.
sentences.i: Zadok answered and said: No, O lord, for I took from her three garments (?), that is, the one upon her; and I clothed her in the one you gave me, and I brought it to you.
sentences.n: The spelling here is ሰዶቅ, against ሳዶቅ earlier; the source prints both (a spelling variation, kept as printed). አልቦ 'there is not', used here as 'no'. እግዚኦ 'O lord' (vocative -ኦ). ፫ is the numeral 3, standing as its own word before ልብስ (the build reads it as ሠለስቱ 'three'); ልብስ is singular in form, 'garment', with the number. በኀቤሃ 'from beside her'. ነሣእኩ 'I took' (1st singular). ወአልበስክዋ 'I clothed her'. ወሀብከኒ 'you gave me'. ወአምጻእኩ 'I brought' (አምጽአ 'bring'). The sense of the three garments is loose: she is put in a replacement, and Zadok brings the king her own.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ሖርኬ ፡ አፍጥን ፡ ነጽሮታ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ ወርእያ ፡ ጥዩቀ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: Go-then, hasten to-look-at-her, our-lady, and-see-her closely.
sentences.i: And he said to him: Go, then; hasten to look at our lady, and see her closely.
sentences.n: ሖርኬ 'go, then' (ሖረ imperative + ኬ 'now / then'). አፍጥን 'hasten' (imperative of አፍጠነ). ነጽሮታ 'to look at her' (ነጽሮ 'looking' + ታ 'her'), ለእግዝእትነ 'our lady' repeating the object. ወርእያ 'and see her', ጥዩቀ 'exactly, closely' (adverbial accusative).

sentences.t: ወነሥአ ፡ መራኁተ ፡ ሰዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወፈትሐ ፡ ኀዋኅወ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ ወአፍጠነ ፡ ነጽሮ ፡ ወኀሢሠ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘረከበ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ለውሕ ፡ ጥጉዓን ፡ በአረፍተ ፡ ምንባሪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ዘአስተማሰለ ፡ አዛርያስ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-took keys Zadok priest, and-went, and-opened gates-of house-of sanctuary, and-hastened to-look and-to-search, and-there-is-not what he-found except planks-of ለውሕ (?) firm (?) at-sides-of (?) her-seat (?), of-Zion, which made-the-likeness (?) Azaryas.
sentences.i: And Zadok the priest took the keys, and went and opened the gates of the house of the sanctuary; and he hastened to look and to search, and he found nothing except firm (?) boards (?) of wood at the sides (?) of Zion's seat (?), which Azariah had made as her likeness (?).
sentences.n: The spelling is ሰዶቅ again. መራኁተ 'keys' (accusative, plural of መርኆ). ኀዋኅወ ቤተ መቅደስ 'gates-of house-of sanctuary' (double construct). አፍጠነ ነጽሮ ወኀሢሠ 'he hastened to look and to search' (infinitives). ወአልቦ ዘረከበ 'and there is not what he found'. ዕፀወ ለውሕ ጥጉዓን is UNCERTAIN in each word: ዕፀወ is the plural of ዕፅ 'wood' (or the construct), ለውሕ may be 'tablet / board' (?), ጥጉዓን may mean 'firm, solid' (?, compare ጠግዐ in unit 8, 'congealed'). በአረፍተ ምንባሪሃ is UNCERTAIN: አረፍት 'sides / edges' (?, recurring from unit 8) and ምንባር 'seat, place of sitting' (?) with ሃ 'her'; ለጽዮን names her. ዘአስተማሰለ አዛርያስ 'who made-the-likeness, Azaryas': አስተማሰለ is the causative-reflexive of ማሰለ 'be like', 'made a copy', and ዘ- is the relative; Azaryas is Zadok's son (ch. 43, 45), who in ch. 45 had boards made to stand in for Zion; the house English is 'Azariah'. So the king's dream is confirmed: the real Zion is gone and only a copy's boards remain. Five ፨ close the chapter, kept on this unit.
